summary: This directory provides Material UI-based layout components designed to organize form structures and individual form fields. It establishes a consistent visual presentation for input elements and form groupings using grid systems and specific styling conventions.
responsibilities: Define structural layouts for form-based user interfaces
Arrange form fields and labels using a grid system
Provide consistent containers for displaying form content and validation errors
relationships: Form layouts provide the overarching structure that contains individual field layouts within a consistent grid system.
Field layouts utilize error display mechanisms and label placement to present individual inputs consistently within the form grid.
designDecisions: Utilization of Material UI components for structural styling
Standardization of form grid patterns for consistent alignment
Separation of concerns between high-level form structure and individual field-level presentation
